description: Opt-in @group(1) sim ring: an indexable storage-buffer ring for particles / walkers / photons. Group 0 is at the contract ceiling (bindings 0–13, 2 storage buffers, 4 storage textures), so persistent agents live here instead of in extraBuffer or plasmaBuffer. Shaders that never declare @group(1) keep the single-layout pipeline. Keep in sync with src/renderer/webgpu/simRing.ts (createSimRingBindGroupLayout) — enforced by `npm run verify:device-policy`.

bindings.name: simState
bindings.note: Live agent state, one vec4<f32> per element. Written by simState-domain passes.

bindings.name: simIndex
bindings.note: Byte-for-byte snapshot of simState taken by the copy barrier (4 u32 words per state element; bitcast<vec4<f32>> to read). The buffer twin of dataC.

bindings.name: simParams
bindings.note: All u32. stateCount = allocated vec4 elements; indexCount = stateCount * 4; frame = frames since the ring was (re)armed; truncated = 1 when the OOM ladder allocated fewer elements than requested.

wasm.note: WASM_BACKEND_POLICY.md feature freeze: the C++ pipeline keeps bindGroupLayoutCount = 1 and src/wasm/bridge/shader.ts refuses @group(1) WGSL before LoadShader (logged skip, never an emdawn abort).
